editorial.claim: This short‑term dip illustrates that even as the sector grows, individual funds can experience volatility.
Readers should treat the 10% figure as a projection rather than a guarantee.
Spot Bitcoin ETFs now own a measurable slice of the Bitcoin supply, and the momentum suggests they could soon hold one‑tenth of all coins.
The evidence highlights a growing concentration of assets in cold storage, a projected three‑year timeline to the next milestone, and important questions about market dynamics.
